Embedding request with explicit encoding_format of float returns float array embeddings

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"encoding_format\":\"float\",\"input\":\"Test input\",\"model\":\"text-embedding-3-small\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.embed(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.data[0].embedding)
```
